description: Fetch a landing page by slug. detail='full' (default) returns full data JSONB plus previewUrl (public GUI preview link) and webUrl (dashboard editor link); 'medium' returns summary + sectionKeys/sectionWordCounts + previewUrl + webUrl; 'short' returns id/slug/name/status. Section bodies and rendered HTML appear only at full. Includes `distribution`: 'hosted' (default, PostKing/universal-lp serves it) 'self_hosted' (the customer runs their own renderer against the public API) or 'external' (their own site serves it) — see set_landing_page_distribution.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "full". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: view_landing_page
